__1 An inspired poet or sage, a singer of sacred hymns, (e. g. कुत्स, वसिष्ठ, अत्रि, अगस्त्य &c.). (These Ṛṣis form a class of beings distinct from gods, men, Asuras &c. ([[

]]). They are the authors or seers of the Vedic hymns; ऋषयो मन्त्रद्रष्टारो वसिष्ठादयः; or, according to Yāska, यस्य वाक्यं स ऋषिः, i. e. they are the persons to whom the Vedic hymns were revealed. In every Sūkta the ऋषि is mentioned along with the देवता, छन्दस् and विनियोग. The later works mention seven Ṛṣis or saptarṣis whose names, according to [[Śat. Br.]], are गौतम, भरद्वाज, विश्वामित्र, जमदग्नि, वसिष्ठ, कश्यप and अत्रि; according to Mahābhārata, मरीचि, अत्रि, अङ्गिरस्, पुलह, क्रतु, पुलस्त्य and वसिष्ठ; Manu calls these sages Prajāpatis or progenitors of mankind, and gives ten names, three more being added to the latter list, i. e. दक्ष or प्रचेतस्, भृगु and नारद. In astronomy the seven Ṛṣis form the constellation of “the Great Bear”); यत्रा सप्त ऋषीन् पर एकमाहुः [[

.]] 
__2 A sanctified sage, saint, an ascetic, anchorite; (there are usually three classes of these saints;) देवर्षि, ब्रह्मर्षि and राजार्षि; sometimes four more are added; महर्षि, परमर्षि, श्रुतर्षि and काण्डर्षि. 
__3 A ray of light. 
__4 An imaginary circle. 
__5 A hymn (मन्त्र) composed by a Ṛṣi; एतद्वोऽस्तु तपोयुक्तं ददामीत्यृषिचोदितम् [[

.]] 
__7 A symbolical expression for number seven. 
__8 Life; [[

.]] 
__9 The moon. 
-Comp. 
-ऋणम् A debt [Page0492-2] due to Ṛṣis. 
-कुल्या 
__1 a sacred river. 
__2 N. of महानदी, N. of सरस्वती; अथ तस्योशतीं देवीमृषिकुल्यां सरस्वतीम् [[

.]] 
-गिरिः N. of a mountain in Magadha. 
-चान्द्रायणम् N. of a particular observance. 
-च्छन्दस् n. the metre of a Ṛṣi, 
-जाङ्गलः, -जाङ्गलिका the plant ऋक्षगन्धा. (Mar. म्हैसवेल). 
-तर्पणम् libation offered to the Ṛṣis. 
-धान्यम् The grain Coix barbata (Mar. वरी). 
-पञ्चमी N. of a festival or ceremony on the fifth day in the first half of Bhādrapada (observed by women). 
-पुत्रकः Southern wood, Artemisia abrotanum (Mar. दवणा). 
-प्रोक्ता the plant माषपर्णी (Mar. रानौडीद). 
-बन्धु a. connected or related to the Ṛṣi; [[

.]] 
-मुखम् the beginning of a Maṇḍala composed by a Ṛṣi. 
-यझः a sacrifice offered to a Ṛṣi (consisting of a prayer in low voice). [[

.]] 
-लोकः the world of the Riṣis. 
-श्राद्धम् Funeral oblations for the Ṛṣis. a figurative expression for insignificant acts which are preceded by great preparation. 
-श्रेष्ठः (ष्ठम्) The pod of Helicteres isora: also the shrub of tree (Mar. मुरुडर्शेग). 
-स्तोमः 
__1 praise of the Ṛṣis. 
__2 a particular sacrifice completed in one day.
a. Praising Ṛṣi; associated with Ṛṣis; शिप्रिन्नृषीवः शचीव्रो [[

ऋषि(षी)कः
 
__1 A Ṛṣi of a lower degree. 
__2 N. of a country or its inhabitants (pl.).
f. A female author composing the Ṛks e. g. Viśvārā, Romaśā &c.
